speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Can you describe the specific position your right leg was in when you were found, and does attempting to straighten your knee trigger severe pain or a clicking sensation?

text: My main symptom is Severe right groin pain. I also have Pain in both knees, Right leg is slightly shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated.
